fieldValues.title: Relation rows are comma-joined, which is unreadable when titles contain commas
fieldValues.summary: The spec requires a relation row to list related instances' labels comma-joined, while a multi-entry field value must never be comma-joined; essay source titles contain commas, so a paragraph's 'Sources' line cannot be read reliably.
evidence: srs-spec.md Relation presentation, Rows (~line 3928): comma-joined, normative markdown form
srs-spec.md Default rendering Step 4 and Multi-entry rows: block list, never comma-joined
Rendered essay: 'Sources: Budd, Lamare & Timming, … (ILR Review 2018) — …, Hibbing & Theiss-Morse, …'
fieldValues.body: A spec change, not an engine bug: relation rows with more than one related instance should render as a block list, like multi-entry fields.
